'''Harido Kavila''' was a famous [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

==Biography==
Realizing that the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] were going to wipe themselves out with their aggressive nature, Kavila invented [[Rodian Theater/Legends|Rodian Theater]], as a way to let loose their violent tendencies. Kavila's intervention is credited with preventing the extinction of the Rodians and instituting one of the greatest forms of theater in Galactic History.
